skills.name: Dueling Heroes
skills.text: During Yan Liang and Wen Chou's drawing phase, they can choose to not draw. Instead, they perform a judgment. The card is then put into their hand. For the rest of their turn, all of the opposite-colored hand cards can be used as Duel.

source.site: English Sanguosha (Jason Keeney and Scott Maresh)
